description: MPT issuance: issuer, supply, scale, transfer fee and flags. When to use: Before accepting or sending an MPT: to check its issuer, decimal scale, supply against its maximum, transfer fee, and whether it can be transferred, locked, escrowed or clawed back. Prefer another tool: To check whether one MPT payment between two accounts can succeed now (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness` with the issuance id as `asset`), or for a trust-line token written `CODE.issuer` (use `/v1/xrpl/token/{asset}`). Example: xrpl_mpt {"mpt_issuance_id":"05FA6AB8561E39FA605779B829BB5974E82B40AF173D6AF3"}

mpt_issuance_id.description: MPT issuance id: 48 hexadecimal characters, either case

name: xrpl_mpt

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

asset_scale.description: Decimal places of the display values: base units / 10^asset_scale

auditor_encryption_key_present.description: True when the issuance sets AuditorEncryptionKey; the key value is not served

confidential_outstanding_amount.description: Part of outstanding_amount held in confidential balances (ConfidentialOutstandingAmount) in display units of the MPT: confidential_outstanding_amount_atomic / 10^asset_scale, exact

confidential_outstanding_amount_atomic.description: Part of outstanding_amount_atomic held in confidential balances, in base units (ConfidentialOutstandingAmount; "0" when absent); already included in outstanding_amount_atomic, never to be added to it

domain_id.description: The issuance's DomainID, a PermissionedDomain id; null when the issuance sets none

can_clawback.description: The issuer can claw back holdings

can_escrow.description: Holdings can be placed in escrow

can_transfer.description: Holders can transfer to each other

locked.description: Every holding is locked: holders cannot transfer

headroom.description: headroom_atomic / 10^asset_scale: the amount the issuer can still issue, against the protocol cap 9223372036854775807 (2^63 - 1) base units without a maximum

headroom_atomic.description: Base units the issuer can still issue: maximum_amount_atomic - outstanding_amount_atomic (MaximumAmount - OutstandingAmount), exact; without a maximum, the protocol cap 9223372036854775807 (2^63 - 1) - outstanding_amount_atomic

immutable_flags.description: ImmutableFlags: the issuance settings frozen for good, one boolean per bit; all false when the issuance has no ImmutableFlags (its ledger default 0)

can_clawback.description: The can_clawback flag can never change (lsifMPTCanClawback)

can_escrow.description: The can_escrow flag can never change (lsifMPTCanEscrow)

can_hold_confidential_balance.description: The can_hold_confidential_balance flag can never change (lsifMPTCanHoldConfidentialBalance)

can_lock.description: The can_lock flag can never change (lsifMPTCanLock)

can_trade.description: The can_trade flag can never change (lsifMPTCanTrade)

can_transfer.description: The can_transfer flag can never change (lsifMPTCanTransfer)

metadata.description: The issuance's MPTokenMetadata can never change (lsifMPTMetadata)

require_auth.description: The require_auth flag can never change (lsifMPTRequireAuth)

transfer_fee.description: The issuance's TransferFee can never change (lsifMPTTransferFee)

issuer_encryption_key_present.description: True when the issuance sets IssuerEncryptionKey; the key value is not served

locked_amount.description: locked_amount_atomic / 10^asset_scale; null when locked_amount_atomic is null

locked_amount_atomic.description: Base units locked in escrow; null when none

maximum_amount.description: Maximum supply (MaximumAmount) in display units of the MPT: maximum_amount_atomic / 10^asset_scale, exact; null when maximum_amount_atomic is null

maximum_amount_atomic.description: Maximum supply in base units; null when the issuance sets none (the ledger limit 9223372036854775807 applies)

metadata_present.description: True when the issuer set metadata; the content is not served

mpt_issuance_id.description: The queried MPT issuance id, echoed in the canonical upper-case hex the route reads

outstanding_amount.description: Supply held by holders (OutstandingAmount) in display units of the MPT: outstanding_amount_atomic / 10^asset_scale, exact

outstanding_amount_atomic.description: Supply held by holders, in base units, confidential balances included

transfer_fee_pct.description: Fee the issuer charges on transfers between holders, in percent (TransferFee / 1000)

transferable.description: True when can_transfer is set and the issuance is not locked

utilization_ratio.description: Share of the maximum supply issued, a fraction: outstanding_amount_atomic / maximum_amount_atomic (OutstandingAmount / MaximumAmount), rounded half-up to 18 places; without a maximum, against the protocol cap 9223372036854775807 (2^63 - 1) that the ledger applies; null only for a zero maximum

title: MPT issuance
